description: This file defines the Psr16CacheAdapter class which implements the CacheInterface to adapt a PSR-16 compatible cache for AWS SDK's usage.

classes.name: Psr16CacheAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that implements the AWS CacheInterface using a PSR-16 compliant cache.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects a PSR-16 cache instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the cache for the given key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional TTL.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry for the given key.
